title: fix(dashboard-filters): spec-form filter options crashed the dashboard; add guide screenshots (#2578)
body:
## Summary

Browser dogfood of the showcase **Revenue Pulse** dashboard (framework's dashboard-level-filters demo, #2578 / framework#2501) caught a real crash and produced the guide screenshots that were the last open docs item.

**The bug**: a dashboard filter declaring static `options` in the `@objectstack/spec` object form — `options: [{ value, label }]`, which is what the spec validates and what framework-authored dashboards ship — crashed the whole dashboard with *"Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {value, label})"*. `DashboardFilterBar` only supported objectui's bare-string shorthand (`options: ['EMEA']`) and mapped each entry as if it were a string.

**The fix** (spec-first, normalized in one place):

- `@object-ui/core` — `resolveDashboardFilterDefs` normalizes both shapes to `{ value, label }` pairs; `DashboardFilterDef.options` is typed accordingly. New test covers the spec object form and the string shorthand.
- `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` — the select consumes the normalized pairs, and the trigger now shows the selected option's **label** rather than its raw value (previously picking `{ value: 'amer', label: 'AMER' }` would have displayed `amer`).
- `@object-ui/types` — `GlobalFilterSchema.options` aligned with the spec union (`string | { value, label }`), interface + zod.

**Guide screenshots** (from the live walkthrough, under `apps/site/public/img/guide/dashboard-filters/`):

- default Revenue Pulse view (filter bar, cross-object KPIs incl. the double-opted-out "Accounts (all time)");
- EMEA re-scope (bound widgets update against their own fields, opted-out KPI holds, Reset appears);
- the Studio widget inspector's "Dashboard filter bindings" section (dateRange → `signed_on`, Region → `sales_region`, Apply/Reset).

`content/docs/guide/dashboard-filters.md` embeds all three and documents that `options` accepts both the spec object form (canonical) and the string shorthand.

## Verification

- Reproduced the crash in a real browser (console dev against a live showcase backend), applied the fix, and re-drove the full flow: filter bar renders, region/date changes live re-scope invoice **and** account widgets against their own fields, Reset appears when dirty, Studio inspector edits bindings visually.
- `pnpm vitest run packages/core packages/plugin-dashboard packages/types` — 1323 passing.
- `core` / `plugin-dashboard` / `types` builds clean; doc-link check reports no new breaks.
- Changeset: patch for the three packages.

Paired framework PR (same branch name): seed-date spread so the demo windows show visible account activity.

Refs #2578, framework#2501
